title: Miserere mei, Domine (Vallicelliana Partbooks) (Lhéritier)
desc: Jean Lhéritier, Miserere mei, Domine (Vallicelliana Partbooks). 6 voices (Superius, Altus I, Altus II, Tenor II, Tenor I, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Vallicelliana Partbooks. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
